subject: Physics
q: Particle 1 moves along the x-axis with x(t) = 10 + 8t - 3t², while particle 2 moves along the y-axis with y(t) = 5 - 8t³. At t = 1 s, the speed of particle 2 measured in the frame of particle 1 is √v m/s. Find v.
hint: Differentiate both position functions, then subtract the velocity vectors.
solution: At t = 1 s, particle 1 has velocity (8 - 6t)i = 2i m/s and particle 2 has velocity -24t²j = -24j m/s. Hence the velocity of particle 2 relative to particle 1 is -2i - 24j, whose speed is √(2² + 24²) = √580 m/s. Therefore v = 580.
